# TRANSITION INTO DISCOVERY

"Got it.

That gives me a better understanding of what's frustrating you right now.

Let me ask a few questions about the business itself so I can understand where things stand today."

---

# DISCOVERY

## BIGGEST BOTTLENECK

"If you had to point to one thing that's holding the practice back right now, what would it be?"

(Pause)

"What's that costing you in revenue, time, or stress?"

---

## TRANSITION TO REVENUE

"That makes sense.

Let's put some numbers around it so I can better understand the impact."

---

## CURRENT REVENUE

"What did the practice generate last month?"

"What would you say your average monthly revenue is?"

"What was your best month ever?"

---

## TRANSITION TO GOALS

"Perfect.

Now that I understand where the business is today, let's talk about where you're trying to take it."

---

## GOAL REVENUE

"Where would you like the practice to be in the next 12 months?"

(Pause)

"Why is that number important to you?"

(Pause)

"What happens if you don't get there?"

---

## TRANSITION TO ACQUISITION

"That helps me understand the target.

Now let's talk about how patients are currently finding you."

---

## ACQUISITION

"Where are most of your new patients currently coming from?"

"What's working?"

"What's not working?"

---

## TRANSITION TO RETENTION

"Most owners focus heavily on acquisition, but some of the biggest opportunities are often inside the patients you already have."

---

## RETENTION & MEMBERSHIPS

"What percentage of your patients come back after their first treatment?"

(Pause)

"Do you currently offer memberships, packages, wellness programs, or recurring revenue services?"

(Pause)

"If I looked at your business today, where do you think more growth exists:

Getting more patients?

Or getting more value from the patients you already have?"

---

## TRANSITION TO PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS

"That gives me a good picture of where the opportunities are.

Now let me ask—what have you already tried to improve these areas?"

---

## PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS

"Have you worked with agencies?"

"Consultants?"

"Coaches?"

(Pause)

"What worked?"

"What didn't?"

(Pause)

"What do you wish they had done differently?"

---

## TRANSITION TO DECISION MAKING

"One final area I want to understand is how decisions like this typically get made."

---

## DECISION MAKER

"Do you own the practice outright?"

(Pause)

"Is there anyone else who would need to be involved in a decision today?"

---

## TRANSITION TO PITCH

"Perfect.

Based on everything you've shared, I have a pretty good understanding of where the opportunities are.

Would it be okay if I shared what I'm seeing?"
:::

This keeps the call feeling conversational and consultative instead of like a checklist. Each section naturally earns the right to ask the next question, which will make prospects stay engaged and feel understood rather than interrogated.

## CURRENT

"It sounds like fixing that is pretty important. Do you feel like today is the day you finally make a change?"

## REPLACE WITH

How important is it for you to solve this?"

(Pause)

"What happens if nothing changes over the next 6 to 12 months?"

(Pause)

# FIX #2 — DISCOVERY TRANSITIONS

## AFTER PAIN SECTION

"Got it.

That gives me a better understanding of what's frustrating you right now.

Let me ask a few questions about the business itself so I can understand where things stand today."

---

## BEFORE GOALS

"Perfect.

---

## BEFORE PAST ATTEMPTS

"That helps me understand the target.

Now let me ask—what have you already tried to get there?"

---

## BEFORE DECISION MAKER

"One final area I want to understand is how decisions like this typically get made."

---

# FIX #3 — PERSONALIZED BRIDGE BEFORE PITCH

## REPLACE THE FIRST PART OF THE PITCH WITH

"Based on everything you've shared, here's what I see.

It sounds like the biggest challenge isn't [LEADS].

It's actually [INSERT THEIR PAIN].

And that's important because until that problem gets solved, it's going to continue limiting growth no matter how much effort gets put into the business.

Now, that doesn't mean you don't need more patients.

In most cases, our clients absolutely want more consultations, more patients, and more revenue.

And we help them do exactly that.

But what we've found after working inside aesthetic practices for nearly two decades is that growth becomes much easier when we first identify where opportunities are being missed and then build the right systems to support growth.

After nearly 20 years inside aesthetic practices, I've found growth almost always comes down to three things:

Clarity.

Acquisition.

Expansion."

---

# FIX #4 — MICRO CREDIBILITY BEFORE PILLARS

## ADD RIGHT BEFORE THE THREE PILLARS

"After nearly 20 years inside aesthetic practices, I've found growth almost always comes down to three things."

---

# NEW CLOSE

## REPLACE PRICE DROP SECTION

"The investment for our Done-With-You Med Spa Growth Accelerator is $9,000.

The investment for our Done-For-You Med Spa Growth Accelerator is $15,000."

(Pause)

"Based on everything we've discussed today, do you feel like this is the right solution for helping you achieve the goals we talked about?"

(Pause)

IF YES:

"Great.

Would you prefer the Done-With-You option or the Done-For-You option?"

(Pause)

---

# OBJECTION HANDLING

## I NEED TO THINK ABOUT IT

"Absolutely.

Help me understand what specifically you'd like to think about."

(Pause)

"Is there something you're unsure about?

Something we haven't covered?

Or is there another concern on your mind?"

(Sheila Bella style)

"Usually when someone tells me they need to think about it, they're actually trying to process one of three things:

The investment.

The timing.

Or whether they believe this will work.

Which one is it for you?"

---

## I NEED TO TALK TO MY PARTNER

"Of course.

Is your partner typically involved in decisions like this?"

(Pause)

"What concerns do you think they'll have?"

(Pause)

"If they were sitting here with us right now, what questions do you think they'd ask?"

(Sheila Bella style)

"Let's make sure we answer those now so you're both working with the same information."

---

## WE TRIED AN AGENCY BEFORE

"I hear that quite often.

What happened?"

(Listen)

"That's exactly why we've structured Luxora differently.

Most agencies focus on leads.

We focus on the entire patient journey.

Acquisition.

Conversion.

Retention.

Patient value.

And systems.

Because leads alone don't create growth."

---

## IT'S TOO EXPENSIVE

"I completely understand.

Compared to what?"

(Pause)

"Is it the investment itself?

Or are you unsure the return justifies the investment?"

(Pause)

"Because if we can help you recover $50,000 to $500,000 in missed opportunities, the question isn't whether there's a cost.

The question is whether waiting costs more."

---

## WE'RE NOT READY

"That's fair.

What needs to happen before you feel ready?"

(Pause)

"What specifically are you waiting for?"

(Sheila Bella style)

"Sometimes waiting feels safer.

But often the problems we're discussing today are still there six months from now—only more expensive."

---

## SEND ME INFORMATION

"Happy to.

What specifically are you hoping to see in the information?"

(Pause)

"Because I'd rather answer the real question than send a generic PDF."

---

## FINAL CLOSE

"Based on everything we've discussed today...

What do you feel is the best next step?"

This is strong. The only major changes I'd make before finalizing are:

1. Move **TRUST** before the pitch (not after the transition to pitch).

3. Add a **Revenue Leak Summary** right before the Personalized Bridge.
4. Add a full objection section after Investment and before Final Close.

Sound fair?"

Now, that doesn't mean you don't need more patients.

In most cases, our clients absolutely want more consultations, more patients, and more revenue.

And we help them do exactly that.

But what we've found after working inside aesthetic practices for nearly two decades is that growth becomes much easier when we first identify where opportunities are being missed and then build the right systems to support growth."

---

# MICRO CREDIBILITY

"After nearly 20 years inside aesthetic practices, I've found growth almost always comes down to three things:

Clarity.

Acquisition.

Expansion."

---

# PILLAR 1 — CLARITY

"First, we create Clarity.

Most med spa owners know they should be growing faster, but they don't know exactly what's holding them back.

That's why we start with a comprehensive Revenue Leak Audit.

We uncover hidden opportunities by evaluating patient acquisition, consultation conversion, retention, memberships, packages, follow-up systems, team performance, and operational workflows.

The goal is simple:

Identify exactly where revenue is being lost and where the biggest growth opportunities exist."

---

"Once we have clarity, we focus on Acquisition.

We build systems that consistently attract qualified patients and create predictable consultation volume.

This includes Meta advertising, reactivation campaigns, referral systems, conversion-focused funnels, and patient acquisition strategies specifically designed for aesthetic and wellness practices.

The goal is simple:

More qualified consultations and more predictable revenue."

---

# PILLAR 3 — EXPANSION

"Once acquisition is working, we focus on Expansion.

This is where most of the hidden growth exists.

We increase patient lifetime value through memberships, packages, treatment plans, wellness services, peptides, longevity programs, and retention systems.

We also implement automation, AI tools, follow-up systems, and operational processes that allow the practice to scale without creating additional chaos.

The goal is simple:

More revenue from the patients you already have while building a business that can scale."

---

"So before I explain what partnering together would actually look like...

Do you feel like those are the areas that need to be addressed inside your business?"

"On a scale of 1–10, how confident are you that solving those problems would move the practice significantly closer to your goals?"

We identify the opportunities.

We build the blueprint.

We show you exactly what to do.

Then you and your team implement with our guidance over 90 days."

---

### DONE-FOR-YOU — $15,000

"This is for owners who want help implementing the plan.

Instead of simply showing you what to do, we help build and implement the strategy with you.

We become an extension of your team and help execute the growth plan."

---

# RECOMMENDATION

"Based on everything you've shared with me today, I believe the best fit would be our [DWY / DFY] Med Spa Growth Accelerator.

The reason is because your goal is [GOAL].

And the biggest bottlenecks I identified are [PAIN POINTS].

I believe this is the fastest path to helping you achieve that outcome."

---

# INVESTMENT

"The investment for our Done-With-You Med Spa Growth Accelerator is $9,000.

The investment for our Done-For-You Med Spa Growth Accelerator is $15,000."

(Pause)

"Based on everything we've discussed today, do you feel like this is the right solution for helping you achieve the goals we talked about?"

(Pause)

IF YES:

Would you prefer the Done-With-You option or the Done-For-You option?"

(Pause)

---

# FINAL CLOSE

"Let me ask you this...

Based on everything we've uncovered today, what do you believe is the real cost of doing nothing?"

(Pause)

"And knowing that, what would you like to do next?"
:::

"This is for owners who want help implementing the plan.

"Great.

Would you prefer the Done-With-You option or the Done-For-You option?"

(Pause)

"Absolutely.

Help me understand what specifically you'd like to think about."

(Pause)

"Usually when someone tells me they need to think about it, they're actually trying to process one of three things:

The investment.

The timing.

Or whether they believe this will work.

Which one is it for you?"

---

## I NEED TO TALK TO MY PARTNER

"Of course.

(Pause)

"What concerns do you think they'll have?"

(Pause)

"If they were sitting here with us right now, what questions do you think they'd ask?"

"I hear that quite often.

What happened?"

"That's exactly why we've structured Luxora differently.

We focus on acquisition, conversion, retention, patient value, and systems."

---

"I completely understand.

Compared to what?"

(Pause)

"Is it the investment itself?

Or are you unsure the return justifies the investment?"

(Pause)

"If we can help identify and recover $50,000 to $500,000 in missed opportunities, the question isn't whether there's a cost.

The question is whether waiting costs more."

---

## WE'RE NOT READY

"That's fair.

What specifically needs to happen before you feel ready?"

(Pause)

"Sometimes waiting feels safer.

But often the problems we're discussing today are still there six months from now—only more expensive."

---

## SEND ME INFORMATION

"Happy to.

What specifically are you hoping to see?"

(Pause)

"Because I'd rather answer the real question than send a generic PDF."

---

## WE DON'T HAVE THE TIME

"How much time are these problems already costing you every week?"

(Pause)

"Most owners don't have a growth problem.

They have a capacity problem."

---

## WE NEED MORE LEADS FIRST

"If I doubled your leads tomorrow, what percentage would actually become paying patients?"

(Pause)

"And how many would come back?"

"That's why we focus on the entire revenue ecosystem, not just lead generation."

---

## WE CAN DO THIS OURSELVES

"You're probably right.

The question isn't whether you can.

The question is whether it will actually get implemented."

---

## WE ALREADY HAVE A MARKETING COMPANY

"That's completely fine.

Many of our clients do.

What we often find is that marketing isn't the primary problem.

It's what happens before and after the lead."

---

## WE NEED MORE CASH FIRST

"How do you plan to generate more cash if the current systems aren't producing the result you're looking for?"

(Pause)

"Sometimes the thing we're delaying is the very thing preventing growth."

---

## CAN YOU GUARANTEE RESULTS?

"No one can ethically guarantee a specific revenue number.

What we can guarantee is a proven process for identifying revenue leaks, optimizing systems, and creating opportunities for growth."

---

# FINAL CLOSE

"Based on everything we've discussed today...

What do you feel is the best next step?"

(Pause)

"Let me ask you this...

What do you believe is the real cost of doing nothing?"

(Pause)

"And knowing that, what would you like to do next?"
:::

(Pause)

"And what percentage would come back for additional treatments?"

(Pause)

"That's exactly why we start with the Revenue Leak Audit.

More leads don't fix retention problems.

More leads simply expose the weaknesses that already exist."

"You're probably right.

The real question is...

(Pause)

"Because knowing what to do and consistently executing are two very different things."

(Pause)

"How long have some of these challenges existed already?"

---

"Because the bigger you get, the more expensive the mistakes become."

"More providers.

(Pause)

"Because what I typically hear from owners is that next month turns into next quarter...

and next quarter turns into next year."

(Pause)

"If we were having this same conversation six months from now, what would need to happen for you to be glad you started today?"

---

"You're right.

The economy is uncertain.

That's true for every business owner."

(Pause)

"The question becomes:

Do you want to navigate uncertainty with stronger systems, better retention, and more predictable revenue...

or without them?"

---

## WE ALREADY HAVE A MARKETING COMPANY

"That's completely fine.

We're not necessarily replacing them."

(Pause)

"In fact, many of our clients already have agencies.

What we often find is that marketing isn't the primary problem.

It's what happens before and after the lead comes in."

(Pause)

"How are consultation conversion rates?

Show rates?

Retention?

Membership penetration?

Patient lifetime value?"

"That's where we typically create the biggest wins."

---

## WE NEED TO GENERATE MORE CASH FIRST

"I understand.

But help me understand something.

How do you plan to generate more cash if the current systems aren't producing the results you're looking for?"

(Pause)

"Sometimes the very thing that's preventing growth is the thing we're delaying solving."

---

## CAN YOU GUARANTEE RESULTS?

"That's a great question.

The reality is that nobody can ethically guarantee a specific revenue number because every practice is different."

(Pause)

"What I can tell you is that we've spent nearly 20 years inside aesthetic practices identifying the same patterns over and over again."

"We know where revenue leaks happen.

We know how to find them.

And we know how to build systems that create predictable growth."

"The real question is whether you're committed to implementing the solutions once they're identified."

---

## I'M JUST SHOPPING AROUND

"Totally fair.

Most smart business owners explore multiple options before making a decision."

(Pause)

"What specifically are you comparing?"

(Pause)

"What would you need to see today to feel confident moving forward with the right solution?"

---

## WE TRIED THIS BEFORE AND IT DIDN'T WORK

"I appreciate your honesty.

What specifically didn't work?"

(Listen)

"That makes sense."

(Pause)

"Would it be fair to say the issue wasn't that growth systems don't work...

but that the previous solution wasn't implemented correctly or wasn't the right fit?"

(Pause)

"Because those are two very different things."

---

## IF YOU WERE ME, WHAT WOULD YOU DO?

"If I were in your position...

and I truly believed the problems we discussed were costing me revenue every month...

I'd solve them as quickly as possible."

(Pause)

"Whether that's with us or someone else."

"Because unresolved problems compound."

"The longer they exist, the more expensive they become."
